name: cloudflare-access-error-page
description: Cloudflare One (Zero Trust) Access custom error page that tells each user why they were denied
author: Zero Security Corp

BEARER_TOKEN.description: **Optional at deploy time** — you can leave this empty and add it later via `wrangler secret put BEARER_TOKEN` (the page will show a generic reason until then). Create a custom token at [dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens/create) with **Account → Access: Apps and Policies → Read**, **Account → Access: Audit Logs → Read**, **Account → Zero Trust: Devices → Read**, and **Device Posture → Read**. See the README for details.
